summary: Genenta Science S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting, held virtually on September 10, 2026, deferred the proposal to amend Article 1 of the by-laws to rename the company from Genenta Science S.p.A. to Saentra Forge S.p.A. At shareholders' request, consideration was postponed to allow completion of ongoing evaluations of communication, branding, and corporate identity strategy and further shareholder consultation. The proposal will be taken up at a reconvened Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting on October 8, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. CET. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation were disclosed.
